name: spec-to-pr
description: Fast, evidence-backed Codex workflow for turning briefs, legacy changes, Figma designs, and API contracts into verified draft pull requests.

interface.shortDescription: Turn specs, legacy changes, Figma, and APIs into verified draft PRs.
interface.longDescription: SpecToPR gives Codex a fast seven-tool workflow with one API-first implementation context, conditional functional and design review, scope-aware default gates, separate release-only verification, evidence-backed reporting, and safe draft PR/MR publishing.
defaultPrompt: Use workflow_info, then workflow_start to turn my docs, Figma, and API contracts into a verified draft PR/MR.
Keep API mocks and UI work in one implementation context, and complete api-ready before UI completion.
Use the fast scope-aware gates by default; run full release-only verification only when I explicitly request a release.
